correctness.rationale: For arbitrary pairwise intersection at most r-2, the disjoint cap identity follows from the exact inequality x(H)+x(H′)<=2r-2. The independent Beta(n-1,1) and Dirichlet cap law and its coordinate moment formulas are derived by an affine Jacobian. Hypersimplex uncentered second moment comes from explicit bounded-cube inclusion-exclusion, and all covariances by additive cap subtraction. The coefficient kappa has an explicitly nonnegative polynomial numerator in r-2 and n-r-2, vanishing only in a case excluded by degree-regular full-dimensional hypotheses. The complete checker independently integrates 2199 simplices across five actual convex hulls with matching exact rational volumes, means and all covariance entries, and tests duality and a Fano two-design. Computations do not certify the infinite result; the given proof does.

value.rationale: The structure theorem ties continuous-volume geometric moments to degree and codegree regularity of circuit-hyperplanes for every sparse-paving matroid, not just a finite table. The precise invariance threshold is a natural one-/two-design classification; the exact 6-element example shows that Ehrhart-equivalent and volume-equivalent polytopes can have different continuous-volume centroids. The exact formulas make shape information inaccessible to the known volume/Ehrhart statistics explicit and reproducible. The result is not merely a routine tiny numeric bound or a reparameterization.
